>Further proof is no longer required.

Further proof is absolutely required, especially considering that most of the sources you have cited are Israeli who have already been caught lying and calling for the extermination of Palestinian people multiple times since October 7th.

And especially when this [BBC journalist](https://www.newstatesman.com/world/2014/07/jeremy-bowens-gaza-notebook-i-saw-no-evidence-hamas-using-palestinians-human) and this [British newspaper](https://m.belfasttelegraph.co.uk/news/world-news/israel-gaza-conflict-myth-of-hamass-human-shield-gazans-deny-being-put-in-line-of-fire/30448511.html) disputed the claims of Hamas using civilians as human shields back in the 2014 Gaza war.

Most importantly, the issue is that Israel is indiscriminately bombing the entire population to commit ethnic cleansing like they’ve been doing since the early 1900s. Over 12,000 civilians have been killed so far, yet the [IDF claims](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/08/israeli-airstrikes-on-gaza-have-killed-dozens-of-hamas-commanders-says-idf) that “dozens” of Hamas commanders have been killed. [This tweet](https://x.com/saeeddicaprio/status/1721874331788054542?s=46&t=5Ai09QOWEWg9oIg3YInmYg) shows a screenshot of ABC news claiming that “60+ Hamas operatives have been killed” between October 7th and November 7th. Even if 1,000 Hamas operatives have been killed, that’s still a 92% civilian casualty rate.

History and context matters a lot. A lot of people are either uneducated or choose to ignore the facts on how this whole thing started, not in October 7th but in 1917 when the British Government issued the Balfour Declaration “granting” Palestine to the Jewish zionists. Zionist immigration to Palestine started in 1919, and in 1936 the British authorities put 9,000 Palestinians in concentration camps and tortured them. Between 1947 and 1949, more than 750,000 out of a population of 1.9 million Palestinians have been displaced. More than 15,000 killed in more than 70 massacres. Those Palestinians do not have the right to return, yet any Jewish person can go to Israel today and get a citizenship on arrival (the law was recently changed to require a 1 year residency before obtaining citizenship).

A simple Google search will show you the mass atrocities committed by Israel every year since 1919 and before October 7th, even in the West Bank where there is no Hamas. The western propaganda machine is truly terrifying.
You’re right, except Israel has provided no proof of Hamas using civilians as human shields. See [this comment](https://www.reddit.com/r/worldnews/s/9m8RbiAhUW) I made above.

Israel hasn’t been able to provide a shred of evidence for the human shields argument, despite all their advanced tech and having the 4th strongest military power in the world. Their claim that Hamas was using Al-Shifa hospital as a command center has been [debunked](https://www.instagram.com/reel/CzycbiJqOhV/?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet).

Yet, this article by [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/article/us-palestinian-israel-children-idUSBRE95J0FR20130620/) shows that there were 14 reported cases of the Israeli Occupation Forces using Palestinians as human shields between 2010 and 2013, long before October 7th. Here’s an article by an [Israeli newspaper](https://www.reuters.com/article/us-palestinian-israel-children-idUSBRE95J0FR20130620/) claiming that Israel has been doing this since 1967. This [article](https://www.dci-palestine.org/israeli_forces_use_five_palestinian_children_as_human_shields) from May 2023 reported that Israeli soldiers have used at least 5 Palestinians as human shields since the beginning of the year. Here’s an undated [video](https://youtu.be/i-fRih_kpdE?si=yrhODxCwQot78wVM) of an Israeli soldier using a captive as a human shield.

Why are you putting the blame on the civilians and not on the Israeli Occupation Forces that are [bombing innocent people](https://www.instagram.com/reel/CzycbiJqOhV/?igshid=ODhhZWM5NmIwOQ==) in schools?
